description: Source code implementing asynchronous text-to-speech (TTS) services using WebSocket and HTTP APIs, including classes for WebSocket-based and HTTP-based TTS services with methods for connection management, message handling, and TTS generation.

classes.name: AsyncAITTSService
classes.description: Asynchronous WebSocket-based TTS service supporting streaming audio via WebSocket connection.

classes.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based asynchronous TTS service supporting streaming audio via HTTP POST requests.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for both Async TTS services, including optional language setting.

methods.name: language_to_async_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to its corresponding async language code string.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket-based async TTS service with configuration parameters.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._build_msg
methods.description: Builds a JSON message for WebSocket communication with the transcript text.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket connection and initializes settings.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WebSocket communication.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and initializes communication.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection establishment.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket disconnection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket object or raises error if not connected.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.flush_audio
methods.description: Sends a flush command to the WebSocket to process any pending audio.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame downstream, handling stop conditions.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._receive_messages
methods.description: Receives and processes messages from WebSocket, including audio data and errors.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._keepalive_task_handler
methods.description: Periodically sends keepalive messages to maintain WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech from text via WebSocket, yielding audio frames.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP-based async TTS service with configuration parameters.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to its async language code string.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.start
methods.description: Prepares the HTTP TTS service for operation, setting sample rate.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech from text via HTTP API, yielding audio frames.
